message.reasoning_content: We need to determine appropriate charge(s) based on facts. The case: Defendant Chen damaged a loader and a diesel engine of a sand mining operation, causing property damage valued at 32,601 yuan. He was angry due to land loss from sand mining. He used a hammer to smash equipment. This is intentional destruction of property. Under Chinese criminal law, that is "故意毁坏财物罪" (Intentional destruction of property). The description: "因矛盾纠纷，持铁锤故意毁坏他人财物，数额较大". So the charge is "故意毁坏财物". In the prior examples, they used labels like "违法发放贷款", "容留他人吸毒", "窝藏、包庇;包庇毒品犯罪分子", "失火", "滥伐林木". So they use short Chinese phrase for the crime. For this case, likely "故意毁坏财物". Could also be "破坏公私财物" but standard is "故意毁坏财物". No co-occurrence needed. So answer: [罪名]故意毁坏财物<eoa>.
